layout: each property is a 2D array [P index, T index]; h = u + P/rho; the source header names bilinear interpolation in (log10 P, log10 T); aragog LiquidIronTable reads the cut with a bicubic spline in (log10 P, log10 T)
header_lines: # PALEOS Fe EoS Lookup Table — PROTEUS (live-generated)
# Kind: liquid (Luo24, metastable extension below melting)
# P grid: 1351 pts log-uniform in [1.00000000e+05, 1.00000000e+14] Pa
